name: @w6w-apps/gemini
description: Call the Gemini Developer API — generate content, count tokens, embed content, list models.

w6w.longDescription:
Google's Gemini Developer API generates and embeds content from Gemini's models, and this app calls it directly: generate content from a prompt (including multi-turn, multimodal input), embed a single piece of text or a batch of them, count tokens before a call, and list or inspect the available models.

Content is passed through in Gemini's own request shape rather than flattened to a single string, so conversation history and multimodal input survive intact. This makes the app useful both for one-off generation steps in a workflow and for building a multi-turn exchange across several steps.

This is the Gemini Developer API specifically — the api-key-authenticated surface Google ships for individual developers — not Vertex AI, Google Cloud's separate, service-account-authenticated way of calling the same models. Streaming responses, file uploads, cached content and function-calling tool definitions are not exposed here; a caller who needs the raw model response for a prompt, an embedding, or a token count has everything this app offers.
